# Mailman 3 configuration for reading-group@local.edu
#
# This is the configuration file used by the Mailman core, the command line
# tools (`mailman -C /etc/mailman3/mailman.cfg ...`) and the eval harness
# (`initialize('/etc/mailman3/mailman.cfg')`).

[mailman]
# The "site owner" address.  Messages which must reach a human but cannot go
# to a list owner are sent here.
site_owner: reading-group-owner@local.edu

# Local part used in the From field of messages with no natural reply
# recipient.  Mailman appends '@' and the list's host name.
noreply_address: noreply

# Default language for this server.
default_language: en

# Headers checked (in order) to decide whether a message was sent by a
# member of the list.
sender_headers: from from_ reply-to sender

# Mail command processor will ignore mail command lines after this many.
email_commands_max_lines: 10

# Default lifetime of a pending (confirmation) request.
pending_request_life: 3d

# How long files are kept in the cache.
cache_life: 7d

# Callables run early / late during initialization.
pre_hook:
post_hook:

# Which paths.* file system layout to use.
layout: debian

# MIME filtered messages may not be preserved by list owners.
filtered_messages_are_preservable: no

# Command used to turn text/html into text/plain.
html_to_plain_text_command: /usr/bin/lynx -dump $filename

# Characters allowed in list names.
listname_chars: [-_.0-9a-z]


[shell]
# `mailman shell` / `withlist` settings.
prompt: >>>
banner: Welcome to the GNU Mailman shell
use_ipython: no
history_file:


[paths.debian]
# Runtime directories for this Mailman instance.
var_dir: /var/lib/mailman3
queue_dir: $var_dir/queue
bin_dir: /usr/lib/mailman3/bin
list_data_dir: $var_dir/lists
log_dir: /var/log/mailman3
lock_dir: $var_dir/locks
data_dir: $var_dir/data
cache_dir: $var_dir/cache

lock_file: $lock_dir/master.lck

class: mailman.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase
url: sqlite:///$DATA_DIR/mailman.db
debug: no


[logging.debian]
format: %(asctime)s (%(process)d) %(message)s
datefmt: %b %d %H:%M:%S %Y
propagate: no
level: info
path: mailman.log


[webservice]

hostname: localhost
port: 8001
use_https: no
show_tracebacks: yes
api_version: 3.1
admin_user: restadmin
admin_pass: HtjrFZfKuq+XKKF6748Ay9BISs+63E8zkTuDVPKo35GibShq


[mta]
# Incoming mail arrives from Postfix over LMTP; outgoing mail is handed to

incoming: mailman.mta.postfix.LMTP

lmtp_port: 8024

# Postfix specific settings (postmap command, transport map type).

import mailbox, os, subprocess, sys, smtplib
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from time import sleep

sys.path.insert(0, '/app')
from eval import (add_user, get_mlist, send_email, confirm_last_reply,
                  DOMAIN_NAME, MAILING_LIST, JOIN_LIST, LEAVE_LIST)


def subjects(user):
    mbox = mailbox.mbox(f"/var/mail/{user}")
    return [m.get('Subject', '') for m in mbox]


def join(user):
    send_email(body="", subject="", from_addr=f"{user}@{DOMAIN_NAME}",
               to_addr=JOIN_LIST)
    sleep(4)
    confirm_last_reply(user, "join")
    sleep(5)


def is_member(user):
    mlist = get_mlist()
    return mlist.members.get_member(f"{user}@{DOMAIN_NAME}")


def test_leave_and_post():
    u1 = os.urandom(8).hex()
    u2 = os.urandom(8).hex()
    add_user(u1)
    add_user(u2)
    join(u1)
    join(u2)
    assert is_member(u1) and is_member(u2), "join failed"
    print("both users joined")

    # --- announcement reaches every subscriber
    send_email(body="Book: Dune. Meet Thursday.",
               subject="Announcement", from_addr=f"{u1}@{DOMAIN_NAME}",
               to_addr=MAILING_LIST)
    sleep(8)
    for user in (u1, u2):
        subs = subjects(user)
        print(user, "inbox:", subs)
        assert any("Announcement" in s for s in subs), \
            f"announcement not delivered to {user}: {subs}"
    print("announcement delivered to all subscribers")

    # --- leave requires confirmation, then removes the member
    send_email(body="", subject="", from_addr=f"{u2}@{DOMAIN_NAME}",
               to_addr=LEAVE_LIST)
    sleep(4)
    assert is_member(u2), "user removed without confirming the leave request"
    print("leave request is pending confirmation")
    confirm_last_reply(u2, "leave")
    sleep(6)
    assert not is_member(u2), "user still a member after confirming leave"
    print("leave confirmed, user removed")

    # --- a non-member post is not held for approval
    u3 = os.urandom(8).hex()
    add_user(u3)
    send_email(body="Outsider announcement", subject="From outside",
               from_addr=f"{u3}@{DOMAIN_NAME}", to_addr=MAILING_LIST)
    sleep(8)
    subs = subjects(u1)
    print(u1, "inbox:", subs)
    assert any("From outside" in s for s in subs), \
        f"non-member post not delivered: {subs}"
    print("non-member post delivered without approval")


test_leave_and_post()
print("ALL OK")
PYEOF

#!/bin/sh
# Bring up postfix + mailman3 for reading-group@local.edu.
# Both daemons are started by their init scripts; there is no systemd here,
# so this script is what a restarted container needs to run.
set -e

mkdir -p /var/lib/mailman3/queue /var/lib/mailman3/lists /var/lib/mailman3/data \
         /var/lib/mailman3/logs /var/lib/mailman3/cache /var/lib/mailman3/locks \
         /var/lib/mailman3/messages /var/lib/mailman3/archives \
         /var/lib/mailman3/ext /var/lib/mailman3/templates
chown -R list:list /var/lib/mailman3 /var/log/mailman3 /run/mailman3
chmod 755 /var/lib/mailman3 /var/lib/mailman3/data

# Postfix first: Mailman hands outgoing mail to it over SMTP on port 25.
if ! /usr/sbin/postfix status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    /etc/init.d/postfix start
fi

# Mailman's master runner (LMTP on 127.0.0.1:8024 plus the queue runners).
if ! /usr/bin/mailman --run-as-root -C /etc/mailman3/mailman.cfg status \
        2>/dev/null | grep -q 'is running'; then
    /etc/init.d/mailman3 start
fi
EOF

sh /usr/local/sbin/start-mailing-list.sh 2>&1 | tail -5
sleep 8
